name: Marching Cubes Iso-surface Extraction
definition: A surface rendering technique using VTK's vtkContourFilter to extract 3D surfaces (isosurfaces) from volumetric data based on a specific scalar value threshold, followed by normal calculation for lighting.
summary: Marching Cubes extracts a discrete polygonal mesh from 3D scalar data by interpolating surface intersections within cubic voxels, distinguishing itself from direct volume rendering by isolating specific boundaries.
